guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：光片顯微鏡
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Light-sheet microscopy
guides.concept: 從照明與偵測互相垂直的光路出發，理解光片顯微鏡為何能以極低光劑量做活體與透明化組織的 3D 成像，再把光束腰與瑞利長度、掃描光片與滾動快門同步、偵測取樣、光片共面校正、散射與折射率失配預算、多視角融合與資料管線整合成可交接的光片系統工程。
guides.conceptEn: Start from mutually perpendicular illumination and detection paths to see why light-sheet microscopes image live and cleared samples in 3D at very low light dose, then integrate beam waist and Rayleigh range, scanned sheets synchronized to rolling shutters, detection sampling, sheet coplanarity calibration, scattering and index-mismatch budgets, multiview fusion and data pipelines into a transferable light-sheet system record.
procedure: 光片顯微鏡把照明與偵測拆成兩條互相垂直的光路：照明物鏡從側面送入一片薄光，只激發偵測物鏡焦平面附近的螢光，偵測物鏡則以寬場方式一次拍下整個平面。和寬場或共軛焦顯微鏡不同，拍這一層時焦平面外的分子根本沒有被照到，所以光學切片來自照明而不是針孔，整個體積的光劑量與光漂白大幅降低。代價是樣品必須能從側面進光，並放在充滿浸潤液的樣品槽中，與兩支物鏡的工作距離和幾何互相牽制。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「正交照明與偵測物鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

以高斯光束形成的光片最薄處是光束腰 w0，離開腰後依 w(z) = w0·√(1 + (z/z_R)²) 變厚，瑞利長度 z_R = πn·w0²/λ。習慣上把可用視野定為 2z_R，此時邊緣厚度是中心的 √2 倍；由於 z_R 與 w0² 成正比，光片薄一半，可用視野就縮成四分之一。貝索光束與晶格光片以錐狀角譜延長無繞射長度，但貝索光束的旁瓣攜帶大量能量，在焦平面外造成背景與漂白；晶格光片以干涉圖樣壓抑旁瓣，在厚度、視野與旁瓣之間取得不同平衡。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「高斯光束腰與瑞利長度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光片可以用柱狀透鏡一次形成靜態平面，也可以用振鏡把細光束在焦平面內快速掃過（數位掃描光片），後者強度均勻、可逐行調變，還能做擺動掃描改變入射角，把吸收物造成的條紋陰影平均掉。要突破厚度與視野的取捨，可用電調焦透鏡沿傳播方向移動光束腰，並與 sCMOS 相機的滾動快門同步，讓每一列像素只在光束腰經過時曝光，整個視野都用最薄的那段光片成像。代價是同步時序變成關鍵規格，振鏡、透鏡與相機的觸發抖動直接變成厚度誤差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「振鏡、電調透鏡與滾動快門」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

偵測端本身是一台寬場顯微鏡：物鏡 NA 決定橫向解析度與景深，相機像素換算到樣品端的大小決定是否滿足奈奎斯特取樣。光片系統的軸向點擴散函數是照明光片剖面與偵測軸向 PSF 的乘積，兩者都影響軸向解析度：低 NA 偵測的大視野系統由光片厚度主導，高 NA 偵測時由偵測景深主導，光片則負責壓抑焦外背景。偵測物鏡必須浸在樣品槽介質中，工作距離、物鏡外殼角度與照明物鏡的幾何干涉限制了可用的 NA 組合。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偵測物鏡與 sCMOS 取樣」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光片必須與偵測物鏡的焦平面完全共面：光片中心偏離焦平面會讓訊號下降、背景上升；光片相對焦平面有傾角時，視野一側在焦內、另一側在焦外。校正通常用螢光珠或均勻螢光樣品，依序調整光片高度（照明側振鏡偏移）、傾角（與物鏡後焦面共軛的振鏡或鏡座）與光束腰位置（照明物鏡或電調透鏡），每一項都以影像銳利度或珠的軸向 PSF 為指標。雙側照明時兩片光必須分別對位，並確認兩者在中央重合。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光片傾角與焦平面共面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光片從側面穿過樣品，深處的光要先經過前方組織：散射把彈道光子轉成背景並讓光片變厚，吸收物（色素、卵黃）在其後方投下條紋陰影。樣品折射率與浸潤介質不同時，偵測物鏡看到的焦平面隨深度漂移，光片與焦平面逐漸分離。對策包括雙側照明（每側只負責一半寬度）、擺動掃描、多角度取像，以及組織透明化搭配折射率相符的介質；活體大樣品則需要隨深度動態補償焦距。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「散射、陰影與折射率失配」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

單一視角的光片影像軸向解析度比橫向差數倍，深處又受散射與陰影影響。多視角取像把樣品旋轉或用多支物鏡從不同方向拍同一體積，以嵌入的螢光珠或影像特徵配準，再以加權平均或多視角反摺積融合，得到接近等向的解析度與完整覆蓋。整合時資料量往往才是真正的瓶頸：sCMOS 相機持續以數百 MB/s 輸出，需要串流寫入磁碟陣列、即時壓縮與自動化的配準融合流程，否則長時間縮時實驗無法收尾。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「多視角融合與資料管線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光片顯微鏡的驗收把前面每個模型變成量測：視野多處螢光珠的橫向與軸向 FWHM 驗證偵測解析度與光片均勻性；光片側影驗證 w0、z_R 與腰的位置；共面性掃描驗證傾角；觸發時序驗證同步；重複取像驗證漂白率與熱漂移；連續寫入測試驗證資料管線。交接紀錄必須包含每一組物鏡、介質與光片設定下的校正值，因為換介質、換樣品槽或換波長都會讓舊值失效。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「螢光珠驗收與交接紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A light-sheet microscope splits illumination and detection into two perpendicular paths: an illumination objective sends a thin sheet of light in from the side, exciting fluorescence only near the focal plane of the detection objective, which records the whole plane at once in widefield fashion. Unlike widefield or confocal microscopes, molecules outside the focal plane are simply not illuminated while that plane is recorded, so optical sectioning comes from the illumination rather than a pinhole and the light dose and photobleaching of the whole volume fall sharply. The price is that the sample must admit light from the side and sit in a chamber filled with immersion medium, its geometry constrained by the working distances of two objectives. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Orthogonal illumination and detection”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A sheet formed by a Gaussian beam is thinnest at the waist w0 and thickens away from it as w(z) = w0·√(1 + (z/z_R)²), with Rayleigh range z_R = πn·w0²/λ. The usable field is conventionally taken as 2z_R, where the edge thickness is √2 times the centre; because z_R scales with w0², halving the sheet thickness quarters the usable field. Bessel beams and lattice sheets extend the non-diffracting length with a conical angular spectrum, but Bessel side lobes carry much of the energy and cause out-of-focus background and bleaching, while lattice sheets suppress side lobes through interference, striking a different balance among thickness, field and side lobes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gaussian waist and Rayleigh range”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A sheet can be formed statically by a cylindrical lens or by a galvanometer sweeping a thin beam rapidly across the focal plane (a digitally scanned light sheet); the latter is uniform, modulable line by line and can pivot to change the incidence angle, averaging away stripe shadows behind absorbers. To break the thickness-versus-field trade-off, an electrically tunable lens moves the waist along the propagation direction in sync with an sCMOS rolling shutter so each pixel row is exposed only while the waist passes, imaging the whole field with the thinnest part of the sheet. The price is that synchronization timing becomes a key specification, and trigger jitter among galvo, lens and camera turns directly into thickness error. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Galvo, tunable lens and rolling shutter”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The detection side is itself a widefield microscope: objective NA sets lateral resolution and depth of field, and camera pixel size referred to the sample decides whether Nyquist sampling is met. The axial point-spread function of a light-sheet system is the product of the sheet profile and the detection axial PSF, so both affect axial resolution: large-field systems with low-NA detection are dominated by sheet thickness, while high-NA detection is dominated by detection depth of field and the sheet mainly suppresses out-of-focus background. The detection objective must dip into the chamber medium, and working distance, nosepiece angle and geometric interference with the illumination objective limit the usable NA combinations. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Detection objective and sCMOS sampling”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The sheet must be exactly coplanar with the detection focal plane: a sheet centre offset from focus lowers signal and raises background, and a sheet tilted relative to focus leaves one side of the field sharp and the other blurred. Calibration usually uses beads or a uniform fluorescent sample, adjusting in turn sheet height (an illumination galvo offset), tilt (a galvo or mount conjugate to the objective back focal plane) and waist position (the illumination objective or tunable lens), each judged by image sharpness or bead axial PSF. With dual-sided illumination both sheets are aligned separately and confirmed to coincide at the centre. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sheet tilt and focal-plane coplanarity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The sheet crosses the sample from the side, so light reaching deep regions must first pass through the tissue in front: scattering converts ballistic photons into background and thickens the sheet, and absorbers such as pigment or yolk cast stripe shadows behind them. When sample and immersion medium differ in refractive index, the focal plane seen by the detection objective drifts with depth and the sheet and focal plane separate. Remedies include dual-sided illumination with each side covering half the width, pivot scanning, multi-angle acquisition and tissue clearing with index-matched media, while large live samples need depth-dependent focus compensation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Scattering, shadows and index mismatch”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A single-view light-sheet image has axial resolution several times worse than lateral, and deep regions suffer scattering and shadows. Multiview acquisition rotates the sample or uses several objectives to record the same volume from different directions, registers the views with embedded beads or image features, then fuses them by weighted averaging or multiview deconvolution for near-isotropic resolution and complete coverage. In integration the data volume is often the real bottleneck: sCMOS cameras stream hundreds of MB/s continuously, demanding streaming to disk arrays, on-the-fly compression and automated registration and fusion, without which long time-lapse experiments cannot be completed. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Multiview fusion and data pipeline”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Light-sheet acceptance turns each earlier model into a measurement: lateral and axial bead FWHM at many field positions verify detection resolution and sheet uniformity; the sheet profile verifies w0, z_R and waist position; a coplanarity scan verifies tilt; trigger timing verifies synchronization; repeated acquisition verifies bleach rate and thermal drift; a sustained write test verifies the data pipeline. The handoff record must hold calibration values for every combination of objective, medium and sheet setting, because a change of medium, chamber or wavelength invalidates the old values. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bead acceptance and handoff record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 為了提高訊號把照明功率調高 10 倍並加長曝光，影像更乾淨，但胚胎數小時後發育明顯變慢、細胞分裂停滯；團隊只看影像品質沒有監測生理指標，把光毒性造成的異常當成生物學發現。
樣品槽換新後窗片厚度不同，照明光進入介質時的折射使光片高度偏移 3 µm，所有影像都偏暗偏糊；操作者以提高雷射功率補償，漂白因此加速，而真正需要的只是重新對位。
pitfallsEn: To raise signal the illumination power is increased tenfold with longer exposures, the images look cleaner, but after a few hours embryo development slows markedly and cell division stalls; the team watched only image quality, not physiology, and reported a phototoxic artefact as a biological finding.

A new sample chamber has a different window thickness, refraction where the illumination enters the medium shifts the sheet height by 3 µm and every image is dim and soft; the operator compensates with more laser power, accelerating bleaching, when all that was needed was realignment.

related.transfer: 可遷移「正交照明、光學切片與光劑量」與「光片與焦平面的對位校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；共軛焦顯微鏡的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Orthogonal illumination, optical sectioning and light dose" and "Aligning the sheet to the focal plane" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Confocal microscopy must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦正交照明、高斯光片厚度與視野、軸向掃描同步、共面對位、散射與折射率失配、多視角資料管線；共軛焦顯微鏡則以針孔艾里單位、光學切片厚度、光子預算與雷射掃描系統的校正為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on orthogonal illumination, Gaussian sheet thickness versus field, axial-sweep synchronization, coplanarity, scattering and index mismatch, multiview data pipelines; Confocal microscopy centres on pinhole Airy units, optical-section thickness, photon budgets and calibration of laser-scanning systems, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「正交照明與偵測物鏡」與「共軛焦針孔與艾里斑」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到共軛焦顯微鏡，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Orthogonal illumination and detection” and “Confocal pinhole and Airy disc”.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Orthogonal illumination and detection” and “Diffraction limit and fluorescence switching”.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 光片顯微鏡
history.text: 1903 年 Siedentopf 與 Zsigmondy 的超顯微鏡以側向照明觀察膠體金粒子，是正交照明的起點；1993 年 Voie 等人以 OPFOS 對透明化耳蝸做光片切片成像。2004 年 EMBL 的 Huisken、Stelzer 等人發表 SPIM，在活體胚胎上展示低光毒性的長時間 3D 成像；2008 年 Keller 等人以數位掃描光片記錄斑馬魚胚胎發育；2011 年 Betzig 團隊引入貝索光束平面照明，2014 年在 Janelia 發表晶格光片顯微鏡；2019 年 mesoSPIM 計畫公開了透明化組織用的大視野軸向掃描光片設計。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1903 Siedentopf and Zsigmondy's ultramicroscope used side illumination to observe colloidal gold particles, the origin of orthogonal illumination; in 1993 Voie and colleagues used OPFOS to image optical sections of a cleared cochlea with a light sheet. In 2004 Huisken, Stelzer and colleagues at EMBL published SPIM, demonstrating long-term low-phototoxicity 3D imaging of live embryos; in 2008 Keller and colleagues recorded zebrafish embryo development with a digitally scanned light sheet; in 2011 Betzig's team introduced Bessel-beam plane illumination and in 2014 published the lattice light-sheet microscope at Janelia; in 2019 the mesoSPIM initiative released a large-field axially scanned light-sheet design for cleared tissue. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「正交照明、光學切片與光劑量」到「系統驗收與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Orthogonal illumination, optical sectioning and light dose" through "System acceptance and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
